title.narrative: Output 1.2. Increased institutional capacity of workers’ organizations

description.narrative:
1. The Federation of Trade Unions of Uzbekistan (FTUU), through intensive lobbying of the Government and active cooperation with the Constitutional Commission in the period between May 2022 and March 2023, has been able to introduce most of the fundamental principles and rights at work into the Constitution of the Republic of Uzbekistan. After the adoption of the amendments through the referendum in May 2023 almost all fundamental principles and rights are enshrined in the Constitution: the right to join trade unions (Articles 39, 70, 73); social partnership (Article 115); prohibition of forced and all forms of child labour (Article 44); occupational safety and health, and the principles of non-discrimination and equal pay for work of equal value (Article 42).
2. The FTUU, through active advocacy and lobbying in 2022, has introduced several provisions in the interests of workers into the Labour Code of Uzbekistan and the law on “guarantees of equal rights and opportunities for women and men". The amendments to the Labour Code: the obligation of the employer to offer the employee another job, if, in accordance with the medical report, the employee is contraindicated in performing work stipulated by the employment contract; granting parental leave to the father of the child; payment by the employer for training of the employees or their children; providing first aid to employees and their transportation to medical institutions, investigation and recording of accidents at work and occupational diseases; creation of commissions on social and labour issues at the sectoral, territorial and primary levels, and also significantly expanded their powers and mandate. In addition, the new Labour Code has eliminated the previously existing norm that gave the employer the right to terminate the employment contract with the employee when he/she reached retirement age. For both results, the ILO provided support through several capacity building events including with the support of RBSA contributions:
1. A two-day training for leaders and senior staff members of the Federation of Trade Unions of Uzbekistan (FTUU) on strategic planning applying foresight method (May 2022). 2. A two-day sub-regional seminar on the role of Decent Work in ensuring lasting Peace and sustainable economic development (July 2022) with the participation of the FTUU leaders. 3. A seminar for FTUU leaders and senior staff members on the modern tendencies of labour law development and application of international labour standards (November 2022). 4. A workshop on "Gender-responsive diagnostics of the scope, incidence and drivers of the informal economy and employment in the Republic of Uzbekistan" (November 2022). 5. A Regional conference of trade unions of central Asian countries "Trade unions role in harnessing digital transformations for labour market development and securing Decent Work" (October 2022). 6. A study visit of the FTUU delegation to the ILO HQs in Geneva and meetings with several departments and specialists on international labour standards and other areas (September 2022).
